name: angel_of_finality_exiles_the_target_players_graveyard
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, exile target player's graveyard.' Angel of Finality enters, seat 0 targets the opponent as the trigger goes on the stack, and both cards of the opponent's graveyard are exiled; seat 0's graveyard card stays. Engine wave C1 made the trigger lane designate a player a selector's zone names (query.designated_player_refs); before, the trigger raised 'TARGET_PLAYER needs a bound target' as it resolved.
